description: This file contains shell script functions related to firmware upgrade management for a Fortinet device. It includes functions for byte swapping, building partition maps, updating firmware info, and performing the upgrade process, including handling firmware image extraction and flash memory operations.

methods.name: fortinet_bswap32
methods.description: Swaps byte order of a 32-bit value, used for endian conversion.

methods.name: fortinet_by2bl
methods.description: Converts a size value into block count format.

methods.name: fortinet_bl2by
methods.description: Converts a block count back to byte size.

methods.name: fortinet_build_partmap
methods.description: Creates a partition map string with block offsets and lengths based on input arguments.

methods.name: fortinet_update_fwinfo
methods.description: Updates firmware information for a specific firmware partition, including name and size.

methods.name: fortinet_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the complete firmware upgrade process, including extracting kernel and root filesystem images, updating the firmware info, and writing to flash memory.
